scope: ES edition history, current Cloud and CMP prerequisites, scoped SOAR matrix and source-locator reviews.

claimChecks.environment: Premier Cloud and Cloud Connected CMP
claimChecks.assessment: The current 8.8 Premier aggregate Triage/Response row lists Cloud Platform 10.2.x+, ES 8.6+ and paired SOAR; the separate 8.7 and 8.8 Cloud task prerequisites give ES 8.7+. The 8.8 CMP task gives Platform 10.4.x+, ES 8.8+ and Cloud Connect 2.0, with assistant and connector/investigation permissions. The standalone page is readable in publisher-indexed text and adds SAIA 2.4+ as a prerequisite. Its English, Japanese and publisher-hosted direct paths returned 404. The SAIA 2.3.6 installation and known-issue pages still describe 2.4.0 support as planned; the floor is not proof of released CMP support. The current English and Japanese release pages state November 4 GA. Exact October CA and original Triage wording remain unavailable. Exact SOAR pair, individual rollout, entitlement and authorization remain excluded.
